:::{#def-empty-set}
#### Empty set

The **empty set**, denoted $\emptyset$,
is the set that has no elements.

:::

::: {.remark .notes}

Other sources write $\set{}$
(see [Wikipedia: Empty set](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Empty_set)).
Some sources call it the **null set**,
but in measure theory a "null set" usually means a set of measure zero,
which need not be empty.

:::
